name: AI Playground
author: Uwe Bruckhaus
description: Try out the AI agents on your computer, a test per tab: Analyze shows what an agent and its model can do (green ✓, red ✗), play chess against it, compare speed and cost, judge two answers blind, test vision, make pictures on your own GPU and ask your local LLMs. For now: Claude Code, Codex, Hermes and Pi; other agents follow later. 8 languages.
